The Gift Wrapping Station is a production building unlocked at experience level 17. It is seasonal production machine, and is introduced in winter 2022 update.

It does not need to be repaired or bought. It is given for free, that delivered by Alfred the Mailman on December 5, 2022. It automatically disappeared after December 31, 2022. In 2023, It was delivered by the Mailman on December 11, 2023. It automatically disappeared after December 31, 2023.

It is used to make various types of gifts. They are different in each year.

Upgrading

Main article: Production Buildings

The gift wrapping station originally has two slots available. Unlocking more slots costs diamonds:

  • 3rd slot: 20 diamonds
  • 4th slot: 32 diamonds
  • 5th slot: 44 diamonds
  • 6th slot: 56 diamonds
  • 7th slot: 68 diamonds
  • 8th slot: 80 diamonds
  • 9th slot: 92 diamonds

In 2024, the gift wrapping station originally has two slots available. Unlocking more slots costs diamonds:

  • 3rd slot: 24 diamonds
  • 4th slot: 36 diamonds
  • 5th slot: 48 diamonds
  • 6th slot: 60 diamonds
  • 7th slot: 72 diamonds
  • 8th slot: 85 diamonds
  • 9th slot: 100 diamonds

In 2025, the gift wrapping station originally has two slots available. Unlocking more slots costs diamonds:

  • 3rd slot: 20 diamonds
  • 4th slot: 32 diamonds
  • 5th slot: 44 diamonds
  • 6th slot: 56 diamonds
  • 7th slot: 68 diamonds
  • 8th slot: 80 diamonds
  • 9th slot: 92 diamonds

Strategy tips

  • Recommend to make to order for non-wasting time to wait produced gifts for sparing.
  • Prepare and keep the all ingredients in stock.
